description: Header file defining the TimerManagerImpl class, which manages timers using a factory and event loop, including methods for adding and removing timers, and handling timer read events.

classes.name: TimerManagerImpl
classes.description: Implements a timer management system using a factory and event loop, providing methods to add, remove, and handle timers.

methods.name: TimerManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer manager with a timer factory and event loop.

methods.name: ~TimerManagerImpl
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up timer resources.

methods.name: add_timer
methods.description: Adds a new timer with specified delay, period, and handler.

methods.name: remove_timer
methods.description: Removes a specified timer by file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Handles read events for timers, invoked when a timer elapses.
